name: Hellapeños
review:
Hellapeños is a 5-reel chilli-themed slot set in the devil's own bar, with multiplier wilds, expanding devils and a free spins bonus.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 5,000x cap and a 96.18% RTP.

The expanding devils can cover whole reels, and multiplier wilds then boost those wide connections. Expect cheeky humour and spicy swings in equal measure.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
